_doc: Source of truth for the AI Bubble Watch graph. Bounded to the ~15 largest reported AI deals by value. Every deal MUST have source_url + date or it does not render. Market values are approximate (public market cap or last reported private valuation). Curated manually; Job B proposes additions into ai_deals_proposed.json — never here.
market_values_note: Approximate, mixed as-of 2025–2026. Public companies = market cap; OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI = last widely-reported private valuation. For node sizing only.

deals.note: OpenAI to buy ~$300bn of Oracle cloud compute over ~5 years (purchases begin 2027).
Nvidia to invest up to $100bn in OpenAI, deployed progressively as ≥10GW of Nvidia systems are built out.
6GW AMD Instinct GPU deployment; up to ~$90bn cumulative AMD hardware revenue + a warrant for up to 160M AMD shares.
Oracle to spend ~$40bn on ~400k Nvidia GB200 chips for the first Stargate data center (Abilene, TX) leased to OpenAI.
Meta multi-year cloud-capacity deal with CoreWeave of up to ~$14.2bn (per CoreWeave Q3 2025 disclosure).
Microsoft cumulative ~$13bn invested in OpenAI across 2019–2023 ($1bn / +$2bn / +$10bn); largest backer.
~$12.5bn GPU-secured debt leg of a ~$20bn SPV that buys Nvidia GPUs and leases them to xAI (Colossus 2); Nvidia contributes up to ~$2bn equity.
Microsoft committed ~$10bn of GPU/cloud capacity from CoreWeave through 2030 (CoreWeave's largest customer).
Amazon ~$8bn invested in Anthropic across 2023–2025 (with up to $25bn more committed in 2026).
OpenAI expanded its CoreWeave compute deal by up to ~$6.5bn (per CoreWeave Q3 2025 disclosure).
Nvidia took a $5bn common-stock stake in Intel (217.4M shares at $23.28) under the Sept 2025 agreement; ~4% of Intel.
Alphabet/Google ~$3bn equity in Anthropic to date (~14% stake), with up to $40bn more committed in 2026.
Nvidia ~$2bn equity investment in CoreWeave (at $87.20/share); Nvidia's disclosed CoreWeave stake later ~$3.7bn.

APPROXIMATE — CoreWeave's data centers run on Nvidia GPUs (~250k deployed); cumulative Nvidia hardware purchases are large but not separately disclosed. Figure illustrative; completes the Nvidia↔CoreWeave loop.
